narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to investigate a viral social media observation regarding public art at Banqiao Station being used as dining tables. By interviewing the son of the original artist, the video provides context on the artwork 'Desire in Flight' while humorously addressing the gap between artistic intent and public utility.
